PlexTrac Pricing and Packages
Whether you’re a pentester or leading a cyber security team of 3 or 3,000, we have a package to meet your mission and stay within your budget.
Get Pricing
PlexTrac Package Pricing
Service Provider
Service Provider
Scale service delivery by accelerating pentest reporting and continuously managing threat exposure in a single platform.
Essential
Scale pentest reporting services by streamlining the end-to-end workflow—from scoping through to the final end deliverable.
Core
Go beyond pentest reporting and shift to continuous testing to deliver exposure management and prioritized remediation services.
Premium
Evolve and scale risk-based service offerings that align with the CTEM framework to show a measurable risk reduction over time.
ReportsAggregate findings from all sources into customizable reports.
SchedulerManage your team's workload, schedule new engagements and enable clients to submit scheduling requests.
Content LibrarySave time & ensure consistency with reusable content repositories.
Core Integrations (File Import)Bring findings directly into PlexTrac via file import.
AnalyticsVisualize status across findings and assets, progress, and risk.
AssessmentsCreate questionnaires based on common frameworks or build custom assessments.
Client PortalGive clients web-based access to results and manage remediation and tracking.
Ticketing IntegrationsStreamline remediation with client-level Jira and ServiceNow integrations.
Exposure ManagementManage consolidated finding and asset data to continually assess clients' attack surfaces.
WebhooksUse event-based automations to enable custom client workflows for in-platform event triggers.
Premium Integrations (API)Leverage integrations with leading tools and platforms.
PrioritiesContextually prioritize findings to track and measure risk reduction.
Workflow AutomationDefine rule sets to build automated workflows customized for each client.
Procedures & RunbooksExecute repeatable test plans or run side-by-side tabletop exercises.
Plex AI*Streamline the authoring and analysis of report findings using AI.
*Plex AI is available as an add-on to the PlexTrac Essential, Core or Premium Packages. You must be using a cloud-based version of the PlexTrac platform to leverage AI features

Evan Pena
Managing Director of Professional Services
“PlexTrac is harnessing Google Cloud’s Vertex AI platform to lay the foundation for red teams to produce proactive security reports faster, and with deeper insights, in much less time, said Evan Pena, Managing Director of Professional Services, Mandiant, part of Google Cloud. “We’re excited to see the larger vision PlexTrac will deliver by applying Vertex AI within its platform and the impact that will have on our portfolio of risk management services.”
Paul Nieto III
Penetration Tester, Royal Caribbean Group
“Time to value is second to none… We cut down so much time on report(ing), it is pretty much a one-stop shop.”
